thread.title: Apple target hiked by Morgan Stanley on streaming opportunities

author: morningstar.com
title: Apple target hiked by Morgan Stanley on streaming opportunities
text:
Morgan Stanley analyst Katy Huberty raised her price target on shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) to $245 from $232 on Wednesday, based on her optimism for the company's streaming opportunities. She projects that a hypothetical "Apple Media" bundle consisting of music, original video, and news could generate $37 billion in revenue by 2025, which she calculates as 64% higher than what those services would bring in if offered individually. She estimates that Apple Media could account for about a third of Apple's service revenue growth through 2025. Apple's stock is down 0.8% in Wednesday's session and is on track to snap a nine-day winning streak (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apples-stock-rises-toward-for-9th-straight-gain-2018-09-04). Shares have gained 40% over the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average has risen 19%.
-Emily Bary; 1019ET
